title: Verify Service Advisor cannot reverse a work order invoice
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Advisor role. (reversing a work order invoice requires Work Orders: Delete per spec v33; this role has NO Work Orders Delete).
Note: the role may display as 'Junior Service Advisor' in the build (the spec calls it 'Service Advisor').
The work order already has an invoice created on its Finance tab.
steps:
1. Open the work order's Finance tab.
2. Look for a Reverse option on the invoice; if present, click it.
expected: Reversing the work order invoice is BLOCKED: the action is hidden/disabled or returns a permission error.
